_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

beats.role: the flow field — noise becomes direction

voltage.why: the manufactured organic — Bernini's baroque marble DISSOLVED by procedural noise; the classical ideal melted by the aesthetic of natural-looking-fake
the fractal hiding inside the smooth — fBm is self-similarity smuggled into what looks continuous; the octave stack is recursion wearing a soft face
noise as invisible authorship — the sliders (octaves, persistence, lacunarity) are the hand that manufactures 'nature'; terrain that looks found is entirely dialed
there is no neutral noise — white/pink/brown/blue are ideologies of disorder; every 'random' field is already a shaped distribution, a choice pretending to be chance
